reason: Selected results support matched-sampling comparisons and explicit initial task instructions; these are historical model results, not a verdict on current reasoning models.

candidates.title: Compare debate with independent sampling at the same budget
candidates.rule: Before adding multi-agent debate for arithmetic reasoning, compare independent responses plus majority voting at the same response budget.
candidates.passage: multi-agent debate significantly underperforms simple self-consistency using majority voting.
candidates.finding: On GSM8K, debate scores 83.2 with six responses versus 85.3 for self-consistency; nine-response scores are 83.0 versus 88.2. Extra responses explain an important baseline advantage over single-shot prompting.
models: GPT-3.5 family; exact debate kernel not established in inspected sections
candidates.conditions: Three agents and two debate rounds; response counts are matched, not necessarily exact token or latency costs.
candidates.limitations: Historical models and one reported arithmetic comparison; communication can help other tasks. Equal response counts do not establish equal monetary cost.
candidates.validation_test: Compare single-shot, independent voting and debate using identical initial instructions; report accuracy, tokens, latency and cost over repeated seeds.

candidates.title: Put known requirements into the first prompt
candidates.rule: Before crediting a revision loop with improved constraint following, give the initial-response baseline the same explicit task requirements.
candidates.passage: applying their self-correction prompt on top of model responses from our stronger version of the standard prompting again leads to a decrease
candidates.finding: For CommonGen-Hard, explicit inclusion of all concepts raises initial concept coverage to 81.8; adding the tested correction prompt reduces it to 75.1. This tests prompt completeness in constrained generation.
candidates.conditions: Generate coherent text containing all 20–30 supplied concepts; compare prompts with explicit inclusion requirements.
candidates.limitations: Concept coverage is narrower than overall writing quality. This does not establish that every revision loop hurts or that external feedback is ineffective.
candidates.validation_test: Compare a complete initial prompt, an incomplete initial prompt plus correction, and complete initial prompt plus correction; score constraint coverage and coherence separately.

review_scope: Selected abstract, introduction, methods or main-result sections; not a comprehensive paper or appendix review.
